correctness.rationale: The addition theorem with probability-surface-measure normalization yields Gram G_ell(x,y)=P_ell(x dot y). Antipodal vertex-pair row symmetry forces a six-dimensional relevant parity space and six zero eigenvalues, except when listed parity eigenvalues vanish at low degrees. For odd ell, signed-root geometry has eigenvalues +2 and -2, each multiplicity 3, giving 2(1+2a),2(1-2a); for even ell, three eigenbranches 2(1+4a+b), 2(1-b),2(1-2a+b) with multiplicities 1,3,2, where a=P_ell(1/2),b=P_ell(0). Independently used exact rational Legendre recurrence for all ell=0..19, obtaining ranks 1,3,5,6,... and unique minimal 65/32768 at ell10 of multiplicity one. Constructed 12-by-12 Gram directly from independently enumerated vertices and scipy Legendre at ell=0,1,2,3,4,7,10,19,50,100; sorted eigenvalues match branches within 2.2e-12. The required infinite proof is Bernstein |P_ell(cos theta)|<sqrt(2/(pi*ell*sin theta)): for ell>=20, |a|<1/5 and |b|<11/60, giving all even eigenbranches >1/30 and all odd >6/5, hence larger than 65/32768. The finite enumeration is a certificate only for ell<=19, not the infinite conclusion.
